main_text.p: fcite, confultò & de industria manus suas direxit: Hiph. השכיל Intellexit, Intelligentiam habuit, adhibuit vel confecutus est, Intelligentiâ imbutus, Intelligens factus fuit; Animadvertit, Attendit, Animum advertit: Et activè, Intelligentiâ imbuit, Erudiit, Instruxit, Informavit: Item, Secundatus, Prosperatus fuit: & activè, Secundavit: Præterit. השכיל Instruxit me, 1.Paralip.28.19. מכל־מלאכתי השכלתי Omnibus doctoribus meis intelligentior fio, Psal.119.99. Part. לכל־דרכיו משכיל In omnibus viis suis secundus, 1.Sam.18.14. משכיל Intelligens, Psal.14.2. Infin. להשכיל Ad intelligendum, Gen.3.6. Futurum, אשכילה Erudiam te, Psalm.32.8. Chald. in Ithpah. Particip. מִשְׁתַּכֵּל הוּא Animadvertens, Confiderâns eram, Dan.7.8.

שכל masc. Intellectus, Intelligentia, Prudentia: Secundatio, Successus: טוב שכל Successus optimus, Secundatio bona, Psal.111.10. Sic Prov.3.4. & aliâs, quando nomen טוב adjunctum habet, ut quibusdam placet: משכל Ab intellectu, Job.17.4. Aff. לְמִי שִׂכְלוֹ Pro ratione intellectûs sui, Prov.12.8. Plural. apud Rabbinos, שִׂכְלִים Intelligentia, Mentes angelicæ.
שִׂכְלוּת f. Prudentia, juxta quosdam: Vide & שכל.
הַשְּׂכָּל m. Intelligentia, Nomen ex Infinito, Prov.1.3. & 21.v.16. Cum בהשכיל Cum intelligentiâ, Job.34.35.
מַשְׂכִּיל m. Intelligens, Prudens: Item, Carmen erudiens, Ode didascalica, in titulis Psalmorum.
שִׂכְלָתְנוּ f. Chald. Intelligentia, Dan.5.11. per Apocopam literæ ת Chaldæis frequentem.
שְׂכַל Chald. in Pahel, Perfecit, Absolvit: Est ab Hebræo כלל per Prosthefin literæ ש Chaldaïs frequentem. Præt. וְשׁוּרַיָּא שְׂכַלּוּ Et muros perficiunt, Esr.4.12.

page.notes: Scan is slightly blurred at the lower Hebrew entries. The Hebrew is printed without vowel points, so it is copied consonantally as it appears. The Hebrew of the Esra and Hiphil forms, and the exact form of the headword "שכל" at the foot, are doubtful: the letters are read from the scan and may differ in the original. Italic type in the Latin glosses was not marked. The large headword at the foot is set in a larger Hebrew type. Hebrew letters are not verified against the source.
